author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새·겨울철새, 해마다 수만 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
summary: 저수지와 하천, 강 하구에서 겨울을 나는 흔한 겨울철새로, 잠수하는 오리 가운데 국내에서 월동하는 수가 가장 많다. 댕기흰죽지나 검은머리흰죽지 등과 어울려 무리를 지어 지낸다. 변환깃에서는 가슴과 꼬리 색이 조금 옅어진다. 유럽 동북부와 바이칼호, 사할린섬에서 번식하고 한국, 일본, 대만, 중국 남부, 미얀마, 인도, 북아프리카 등지에서 월동한다.

art.subject: Common Pochard (Aythya ferina), adult male in winter, as seen on Korean reservoirs from November to March: head and neck rich chestnut-red; breast black; back and flanks very pale grey with fine vermiculations, looking almost whitish-grey at a distance; tail and undertail coverts black. Bill black at the base and tip with a broad pale blue-grey band across the middle; red eye; grey legs.
art.pose: swimming on open water among a loose flock of diving ducks
art.scene: Korean winter reservoir with calm open water and dry reeds along the margin; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: chestnut-red head and neck with a sloping wedge profile, red eye, black breast, pale grey body, black tail end, black bill with a broad pale grey band
adult female, side view swimming: brown head and breast, grey-brown body, rounded buff cheek line through the eye, faint whitish line behind the eye, dark eye, dark bill with a pale band
art.build: Medium-sized diving duck, about 45cm, clearly smaller and shorter-bodied than a Mallard, sitting low and compact on the water with a short tail. Head with a peaked crown and a long, sloping forehead running straight into the long bill, giving a wedge-shaped profile. Bill about as long as the head, broad. Legs short, grey, set far back. Dives often. In flight grey wings with a pale grey (not white) stripe along the flight feathers.
avoid: Do not paint a green or purple-glossed head; the male's head is chestnut-red.
Do not paint an all-black or all-grey bill; it has a pale band across the middle.
Do not paint a white wing-bar in flight; the wing stripe is pale grey.
Do not give it a crest or a rounded, Mallard-like head profile.
